# NOAPPROVAL-001 — fixture PID missing only the approval-evidence section

Proves: four out of five is not valid. Identity holds, and purpose, scope and
acceptance criteria all have substantive content, so exactly one reason fires —
the missing approval evidence.

This is the single most important negative case the rule carries, because
approval evidence is the requirement that cannot be satisfied by an engineer
writing more prose. A PID with no record of its own approval is a document
nobody authorised, however complete the rest of it reads.

## Purpose

State why the work exists, in enough genuine words to clear the distinct-word
floor without padding.

## Scope

Describe what is and is not being built, again in real prose rather than a
repeated meaningless token.

## Acceptance

List what GREEN would mean, with enough distinct words to count as substantive
content.
